description: Deploy a GitHub repo to VibeKit hosting, live at <subdomain>.vibekit.bot (Fargate container behind nginx, SSL automatic). Use when the code already lives in a GitHub repo; for a starter template instead use vibekit_create_app.

subdomain.description: Desired subdomain — the app goes live at <subdomain>.vibekit.bot. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

name: vibekit_deploy

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit Deploy
